notes:
This version is required: Meki Cloud sync asks older Macs to update.

Fixed
- Remove Meki Cloud and Back up only never count a copy on another Mac, or one that is leaving this Mac, when they free Meki Cloud copies; they wait and say which photos need a copy Meki can check
- Removing a drive tells Meki Cloud first and waits for its answer before any photo is purged, so no other Mac goes on counting that drive’s copies
- Removing an archive drive purges exactly the photos Meki Cloud was asked about
- Turning a backup role off with “Also delete the files” finishes its clean-up after a quit, and never deletes files a restored or newer catalog put on the drive
- A failed offload no longer starts again on every background pass, and Offload now… replaces the old error
- With tile corners on, the warning on a photo nothing can bring shows again, centred on the tile
- Device toasts keep up to date when no devices are listed
